profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ADVINT - Advanced Integration, LLC | LabVIEW, Software Design
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at ADVINT - Advanced Integration, LLC, I develop software using the NI software suite for various clients in the military, medical, and commercial sectors. I also assist in IT tasks in an ITAR facility, ensuring compliance with strict regulations.

In addition to my current role, I have experience as a Research Assistant at Ohio University, where I led a software project on the design of a cluster computer for laser acoustic emission feature extraction. I worked with MPI and Nvidia CUDA technology, as well as TCP/UDP socket programming. Prior to that, I was a Laboratory Aide at Ohio University, where I designed and implemented new ways to introduce first-year students to mechanical engineering, performed regular audits, inventory, and safety checks on all mechanical engineering labs, and collaborated with numerous faculty members and students. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Ohio University, with a focus on Computer Engineering.
